evals.prompt: Our serverless inference endpoint returns throttling errors and slow first responses after idle periods.
evals.expected_output: The answer identifies cold start combined with concurrency limits as the cause: scaling from zero takes time and concurrent requests beyond the configured maximum are throttled while capacity warms. It prescribes raising max concurrency, provisioned concurrency, or client-side retry with backoff, and is honest that cold start is inherent to the model.
assertions: The response identifies cold start from scale-to-zero as the cause of the slow first response
The response connects the throttling to the configured concurrency limit
The response is honest that cold start cannot be eliminated entirely on serverless
The response gives concrete mitigation options
